entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to return something. I feel terrible about it, I was so excited to get it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0125. It's for the Trail Helmet. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never returned anything before.
Thank you, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered on December 27th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It's just... some things came up and I really need the money back. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the **box** is still **unopened**. I just feel awful about it.
I completely understand that circumstances can change. Let me quickly check the return eligibility for that specific **helmet** for you.
Oh, thank you. I was so worried. I loved the **color** online, but I just can't justify keeping it right now.

Okay, I've confirmed it. You're in luck. The Trail Helmet falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since it's only been 27 days, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and start that return process for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you. When I can afford it again, I'll definitely be back; **safety** is so important and you guys make the best gear.

We'd be happy to have you back. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for your help, David. You've really turned my day around.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
